findings.title: Output hardlink can overwrite immutable acquisition dump
findings.reproduction: Temporary synthetic audited fixture; output outside bundle was os.link(snapshot000/ram.bin). --json resolve guard passes, write_json truncates linked inode and CLI exits0. Before8192bytes;after4297bytes.
findings.impact: A declared immutable audited acquisition can be changed while returning a successful comparison whose source SHA refers to pre-write data.
findings.recommendation: Write JSON via new temporary inode + atomic replace in target directory, or refuse hardlinked/existing alias outputs and compare samefile against session inputs. Include outputimmutability hardlink negative test. Preserve ordinary insidebundle/symlink resolution guard.
findings.retest: Existing hardlink/symlink/insidebundle/labels overwrite rejected with source hashes intact. Hardlink introduced at replace-time did not truncate sourceinode; output is distinctinode. CurrentROM protected; changedanalyzer guardrejected.
